primer: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd (NSE: GRWRHITECH) pivoted from commodity BOPET into specialty films, now 86% of sales (51% Sun Control, 24% PPF). H1 FY27 delivered 28.7% EBITDA margins, >28% ex-cash ROCE, zero long-term debt, and ₹933 Cr cash. Pass 1 keeps COMPOUNDER_PASS (PASS_WITH_WATCH) while flagging DGTR's <25% Indian PPF share, unverified Finance Ministry duty enactment, and overseas audit footnotes. At the 2026-11-23 close of ₹7,895.00 (43.0x P/E, +8.76% vs 10W EMA), new capital stays WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT in ₹7,250–₹7,650 (target ₹9,300, 1.65:1 R:R). Holding Action: HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP on our 1 held share, with the stop ratcheted up from ₹6,520 to ₹6,650.
